newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago to spend $28 mln in Michigan.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago to spend $28 mln in Michigan.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp's NBD bank said Thursday it would spend $28 million to upgrade and modernize its branch and automated teller machine network in southeast Michigan.
The move is part of a corporate wide review of First Chicago's customer delivery systems that will run through 1998, a First Chicago spokesman said.
In southeast Michigan, NBD Bank will downsize 11 branches and close 25 offices in areas where there is another NBD branch nearby, the company said.
NBD will also build four new full service branches, install 56 new off-site automated teller machines, improve and redesign 95 existing facilities, and relocate five offices to new facilities.
No layoffs are expected, NBD said.
